samples.title: Samples
samples.intro: Ask a supplier for a sample before you place a bulk order. You pay for the sample, if it has a price, directly to the supplier.
samples.notAvailable: Sample requests are not available yet.
samples.emptyDesc: Open a product that offers samples and choose Request a sample.
samples.waitingSupplier: Waiting for the supplier, who replies by {date}
samples.paymentAdjustable: The supplier will adjust this against your bulk order
samples.paymentNotAdjustable: Not adjustable against a bulk order
samples.paymentOffPlatform: Payment happens outside cnote. We only keep a record.
samples.decline_not_offered: Samples are not offered for this product
samples.decline_region_not_served: Does not deliver to your area
samples.decline_quantity_too_high: Quantity is too high for a sample
samples.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
samples.evalTitle: Is this sample what you need?
samples.evalIntro: An approved sample becomes the quality reference (the golden sample) for your bulk order. Tell the supplier what is wrong if it is not.
samples.reasonsLegend: What is wrong? Choose at least one.
samples.reject_not_as_described: Not as described in the listing
samples.photosHint: Up to 5 JPEG, PNG or WebP photos, 5 MB each. The supplier can see them.
samples.bulkIntro: Your approved sample is attached as the quality reference, so the supplier knows exactly what to match.
samples.rfqBanner: Bulk request from your approved sample of {title}. The supplier will see it as the quality reference.
samples.goldenIntro: Bulk supply for this order should match the sample the buyer approved on {date}.
samples.offerTier: Only for buyers verified at tier {tier} or above
samples.shipHint: The supplier sees this address only after accepting your request.
samples.slaNote: The supplier has 48 hours to reply, otherwise the request expires.
samples.signInNote: You will be asked to sign in first.
